notes.title: Black Panther Arc Incoming! Dive into the Back to the Dawn 1.0 FAQ
notes.content:
[h2][b]Back to the Dawn 1.0 FAQ[/b][/h2][p][/p][p][b]1. Q: What is the content and scale of the Black Panther Arc? How long does it take to complete the main storyline?[/b][/p][p]
[b]A:[/b] Bob’s story includes a full 5-act main storyline. In terms of script size and narrative complexity, it surpasses Thomas’s route. It will also take significantly longer to complete. To stay true to Bob’s personality and role, even the dialogues reused from other parts of the game have been rewritten in Bob’s tone to ensure full immersion while playing as him.[/p][p][/p][hr][/hr][p][b]2. Q: Does Bob have different “starting background choices” from Thomas?[/b][/p][p] [b]A:[/b] Yes. Bob enters Boulderton Prison as an undercover cop on a mission, so his background before imprisonment is completely different from Thomas.[/p][p][/p][hr][/hr][p][b]3. Q: When does Bob’s story begin, and does he also have the 21-day time limit?[/b][/p][p]
[b]A:[/b] Although Bob enters the prison one month earlier than Thomas in the lore, his story starts on the same day Thomas arrives, and he also has a 21-day sentence limit. However, his story is not tied to the mayoral election in Thomas' arc.[/p][p][/p][hr][/hr][p][b]4. Q: Are there new prison scenes added in the full version?[/b][/p][p]
[b]A:[/b] Yes. The Black Panther Route adds [b]22 new scenes[/b] in total, including [b]11 story scenes outside the prison[/b] and [b]11 inside the prison[/b], though the new in-prison scenes are mainly for Bob’s [b]nighttime exploration[/b]. No new daytime prison activity scenes were added.[/p][p][/p][hr][/hr][p][b]5. Q: Does Bob also need to escape prison? Are there any new escape routes for him?[/b][/p][p]
Yes, Bob also needs to escape.[/p][p]And since we already fully explored the prison’s areas when designing Thomas’s route to provide a rich experience, we did not create new exclusive escape routes for Bob. Additionally, for [b]story-related reasons[/b], Bob will not be able to use some of the escape routes available to Thomas. However, even when using the similar escape routes, [b]the experience and presentation will be quite different[/b] due to the difference between Bob and Thomas.[/p][p][/p][hr][/hr][p][b]6. Q: Apart from the main story, does Bob have new side quests?[/b][/p][p]
[b]A:[/b] Yes. Since Bob is already a member of the [b]Sharp Tooth Gang[/b] at the start of his story, he can access more [b]core Sharp Tooth Gang missions[/b]—missions not available when playing as Thomas. His relationship with Bruce also results in a different set of tasks in that questline.[/p][p][/p][hr][/hr][p][b]7. Q: In Bob’s route, will he also help Bam deal with the “entities from another world”?[/b][/p][p]
[b]A:[/b] No. Bob’s focus will be on his own mission, and the role of “junior investigator” will be taken up by Thomas instead.[/p][p][/p][hr][/hr][p][b]8. Q: Does Bob have a romance storyline?[/b][/p][p]
[b]A:[/b] No, he doesn’t. Bob has a more urgent mission to accomplish. If Thomas is trying to save a city, then [b]Bob is trying to save the entire country[/b].[/p][p][/p][hr][/hr][p][b]9. Q: Can Bob also finish the game “without throwing a single punch” like Thomas?[/b][/p][p]
[b]A:[/b] No. Bob’s storyline includes unavoidable battles. As an undercover cop, Bob faces more dangerous foes than Thomas the journalist. So be prepared. We’ve added [b]new combat skills, weapons, and powerful tools[/b] exclusively for Bob. Discover and try them out![/p][p][/p][hr][/hr][p][b]10. Q: Will Bob’s story also feature multiple endings like Thomas’s?[/b][/p][p]
[b]A:[/b] Yes. Bob’s route includes [b]three unique endings[/b] based on player choices, [b]one "descriptive" ending[/b] similar to the “take the money” option, and [b]two newspaper-style failure endings[/b] based on Bob's survival.[/p][p][/p][hr][/hr][p][b]11. Q: Is Bob’s achievement system still based on Tarot cards?[/b][/p][p]
[b]A:[/b] No. Bob will have a [b]completely different achievement system[/b]. What exactly is it? You’ll have to wait and see![/p][p][/p][hr][/hr][p][b]12. Q: I’ve already 100%-completed Thomas’s route, and Boulderton Prison feels like home. Will Bob’s route still be fun and surprising?[/b][/p][p]
[b]A:[/b] Absolutely. Trust us.[/p][p][/p][hr][/hr][p]This concludes the FAQ for now. If you have any more questions, feel free to reach out via Steam or our social media platforms.[/p][p][/p][hr][/hr][p]Also, the [b]Steam Summer Sale[/b] is almost here! From [b]June 27 to July 11[/b], [i]Back to the Dawn[/i] will be available at its [b]lowest-ever 15% off[/b] discount![/p][p][/p][p]This summer sale is the [b]last chance before the 1.0 full release[/b] to grab the game at a discount and get the [b]Supporter Pack for free[/b]. Don’t miss it![/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41416966/ea44b205ea42921d0b0bf6f7cf955ea00f0d0b01.jpg"][/img][/p][p]May the [b]Father of the Forest[/b] bless you all~[/p][p][/p][p][url="https://discord.gg/eDZ5pkDruq"]Discord[/url] | [url="https://twitter.com/backtothedawn"] Twitter[/url] | [url="https://www.tiktok.com/@backtothedawngame"]Tiktok[/url] |[/p]

notes.title: New Story. Same Prison. Higher Stakes.
notes.content:
Greetings Inmates!

We’re thrilled to announce that after months of polish and refinement, Back to the Dawn will be [b]leaving Early Access[/b] and officially [b]launching its 1.0 Version this July[/b]! And yes, the highly anticipated [b]Black Panther Arc[/b] is finally coming!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41416966/bb3c4d9892093817011edd9b9ca27983af92575c.jpg[/img]

In the 1.0 release, players will be able to experience the brand-new Black Panther storyline featuring multiple new quests and never-before-seen areas. Take on the role of Bob, the undercover cop, and infiltrate Boulderton Prison. Uncover suspicious clues, investigate the deeper conspiracy brewing beneath the surface—and find your way out before it’s too late.

This arc will carry a more cinematic tone, with layered characters and morally grey dilemmas. Get ready for grander storytelling, intense twists, and unforgettable setpieces.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41416966/813e76d3b7abc8b59661beb825904453e7b576a7.gif[/img]

Alongside the 1.0 release, we will also be launching the [b]Supporter Pack[/b], which includes exclusive bonus content (to be revealed soon—stay tuned!). As a token of appreciation for your continued support, [b]anyone who purchases the base game before the 1.0 launch will receive all the Supporter Pack content for free.[/b]

The countdown to Boulderton’s reckoning has begun. Brace yourselves. It’s time to break through the walls and fight your way back to the dawn!

With the launch coming up so shortly, we are also hosting a variety of exciting events leading up to it—for example...

[h3]Our Discord Fanart Competition![/h3]
If you've always wanted to show off your artistic skills, hop onto our Discord server and stand a chance to win Back to the Dawn game key and T-shirt! 

https://discord.gg/bTmpY2J2EF

If you haven’t already, do follow us on our social media channels to stay up to date on all our latest content lined up for the future. So be sure to follow our socials and don’t miss out on the opportunities! That's all for today, and we hope you're excited for what's to come.

notes.title: V1.3.84.8 Bug Fixes!
notes.content:
Greetings inmates!

Thank you for your support and feedback for our last update with Thomas! For today's update, we've conducted a new round of fixes and optimizations to improve your gaming experience.

[h2]Game Optimizations[/h2]
[list]
[*] When purchasing items gifted to other prisoners, they will retain their original attributes and durability will not refresh.
[*] You can now use the pen placed in the cabinet directly from the desk in your cell.
[*] The contraband value of important items in your backpack will now be read correctly.
[*] The contraband value of the items “Parole Certificate” and “Prison Letterhead Paper” has been reduced.
[*] Added sound effects for the diving mini-game, Easter eggs, and transitions.
[*] Corrected some traditional Chinese typos.
[*] Reduced the brightness in the bakery and bookstore on the commercial street, removed the fog animation, added wind-blown tree effects, and toned down the grass movement.
[*] Improved the character's standing posture during NPC interactions.
[*] Performance optimization: animations for the white marker will now be hidden when not visible.
[/list]
[h2]Bug Fixes[/h2]
[list]
[*] Fixed the issue while performing the action “Assemble a wooden bridge with a hammer in the sewer.” did not consume stamina.
[*] Fixed the issue where the crocodile not being present on the playground on Day 8 in the afternoon would cause the ransom event to freeze.
[*] Fixed the issue where the character animation in the laundry room for the Panther was incorrect during a certain branch on Day 20.
[*] Fixed the issue where the game would freeze when picking up a reflective object in the kitchen club if the backpack was full.
[*] Fixed the issue where plants on the rooftop construction site were not interactive.
[*] Fixed the issue where the character could pass through the upper-left iron door when the screen went black upon entering the first-floor lobby.
[*] Fixed the issue where when another NPC's diarrhea buff disappeared, the log incorrectly displayed that the player's diarrhea buff had disappeared.
[*] Fixed the issue where the “Talk about building a pool” option still appeared after completing the in-depth interaction with the walrus, even in subsequent playthroughs with aquatic animals.
[*] Fixed the issue where the Great White Shark poster effect continued to accumulate after escaping from prison.
[*] Fixed the issue where using white paper from the cabinet while writing a letter would not consume the paper.
[*] Fixed the issue where listening and moving in the fighting arena on the night of Day 12 could potentially freeze the game.
[*] Fixed the issue where moving behind the door after opening the metal mesh door in the north corner of the sewer would cause the game to freeze.
[*] Fixed the issue where the prisoner status icons could be dragged in the prisoner overview screen.
[*] Fixed the issue where using keyboard arrow keys to control movement would also scroll the log page.
[*] Fixed the issue where the audio from the TV in the Level 1 guard room at night would continue to play.
[/list]
That’s all for today’s update! Once again, we greatly appreciate all your support as we continue to work on the Black Panther storyline, and we encourage you to share the game with your friends if you enjoyed playing Back to the Dawn!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1735700/Back_to_the_Dawn/

As always, we value your feedback and suggestions on the latest updates, so please continue to share them with us on the discussion boards :)

notes.title: Thomas New Storyline Content: Now Available!
notes.content:
Hello inmates!

Today, we’re excited to bring you the FINAL prison escape route for Thomas the Fox — “The Devil”! At the same time, we’re happy to announce that Thomas' story is now feature complete!

Since we launched in Early Access last year, we’ve updated Thomas’s storyline with multiple new scenes, escape routes, and a wealth of plotlines. For both new and returning players, there’s plenty to explore: 20+ hours for a first playthrough, and more than 80 hours for those aiming to unlock every achievement! With over 500,000 words of immersive narrative, 8 escape routes, 10+ distinct endings, 48 prisoners to meet, dozens of NPCs, and more than 100 quests to complete, there’s a huge amount of depth to dive into. We deeply appreciate everyone who’s been with us along the way — your support has been a constant source of encouragement for us!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41416966/aab9205748afb5f796ddba37eb4b84854f6465b4.gif[/img]

As for our next plan, we are now fully focused on Bob the Black Panther, with his campaign set for release in the first half of next year, along with the full version of Back to the Dawn! While we work on the Panther storyline, we’ll keep addressing your feedback and fixing bugs. Please continue to follow us as we'll be sharing our development progress on this :)

You can check the progress of the Panther route in our previous announcement: 
https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/1735700/view/4238536974125178649

Now without further ado, here are more details of the new content update:

[h2]Version Update Details:
[/h2]

[h3]New Escape Route — “The Devil”[/h3]
[list]
[*] There’s a basement in the barbershop, and a basement under the basement, and a basement under the basement’s basement...
[*] Meet new friends: the perfect partners “The Devil” and “The Ghost”
[/list]
[h3]Content Optimization
[/h3]
[list]
[*] Added a new intermission scene
[*] Added a new Easter egg scene: The greedy fox gets nothing but Easter eggs
[*] Added new everyday items: “Crowbar,” “Dog Tag of the Dead,” “Beauty Scrub,” “Great White Shark Poster”
[/list]
[h3]Bug Fixes[/h3]
[list]
[*] Fixed some translation errors in Traditional Chinese
[*] Fixed an issue where Tree Frog Gray’s hierarchy was incorrect in a branch on the 21st day in the afternoon at the complex
[*] Fixed an issue where the cost was displayed but not deducted for the bench press in the playground
[*] Fixed an issue where the “All In” skill was not working properly during certain dice challenges
[/list]
Once again, thank you all for your support and love! If you enjoy the game or have suggestions for improvements, please take a moment to leave a review on Steam. We would love to hear your feedback.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1735700/Back_to_the_Dawn/

If you haven’t already, do follow us on our social media channels to stay up to date on all our latest content lined up for the future! That's all for today, and we hope you enjoy Thomas's final update :)

notes.title: New Escape Routes Added & MORE!
notes.content:
Dear Inmates,

Thank you for your patience! We're excited to announce that we’ve got some [b]brand new story content for Thomas[/b] that is coming out TODAY!

[h2]New Escape Route + Scenes![/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41416966/ec498e6e3dd758e9f4dd6b7f0984649f7a775bd3.png[/img]
Discover the brand new "Sun" escape route—a fresh path filled with challenges that will test your wits and determination. Additionally, we've enhanced the storyline in the Guard Activity Room. This area now presents more layers and strategic opportunities as you discover new interactions within a two-story structure bustling with activity. Get ready for an enhanced and more intense adventure in your prison break journey!

Additional, we've introduced two exciting new achievements, "Lover" and "Sun" to go along with these new content update, each designed to challenge your skills and enhance your gameplay experience.

Here are more details of the new content update:

[h2][b]Version Update Details[/b][/h2]

[h3][b]Daily Scenes[/b][/h3]
[list]
[*] Guard Activity Room: A two-story building with two new guards and two new jobs. You can water flowers and spy on the guards' secrets.
[*] North Corner of the Sewer: Unlock a new shortcut and take on “stunt” challenges.
[*] Sewage Room: Give Thomas a spoon, and he can stir up the entire...
[/list]
[h3][b]Prison Break Route – “Sun”[/b][/h3]
[list]
[*] Freelance Evidence: Uncover the mystery of the warden's secretary's disappearance.
[*] More story performances and stages: Choose Thomas's helper; it’s now a show for three.
[/list]
[h3][b]Content Optimization[/b][/h3]
[list]
[*] Added localization: Traditional Chinese.
[*] Updated the sewer scene unlock route, with no impact on players who have already unlocked it.
[*] Added a barbershop task, two prison break tasks, three side quests, and optimized some task logic.
[*] New achievement “Lover”: I fell in love with you at first sight, until the day you left...
[*] New achievement “Sun”: Dive into the darkness, disappear under the sunlight.
[*] New coffee-making mini-game: Special supply for the guards. Test your memory, and don’t add anything “weird.”
[*] New equipment: “Baton,” “Whistle,” “Protective Gloves,” “Gas Mask,” “Rubber Boots,” “Heightening Insoles,” “Sun Pendant.”
[*] New interaction: You can call Miss Barbara for help.
[*] Optimized the stacking and placement logic of backpack items, making crafting or purchasing items smoother.
[*] Improved the experience of selecting list options in controller mode: now you can cycle through the list and quickly exit some option lists with the B button.
[/list]
[h3][b]Skill Adjustments[/b][/h3]
[list]
[*] New skill “Daydreamer”: Choosing “sleep a little longer” when waking up restores 5 health and 5 mentality.
[*] New skill “Mermaid and Siren”: Gain double favorability when interacting with Aquatic Animals.
[/list]
[h3][b]Bug Fixes[/b][/h3]
[list]
[*] Fixed the issue of characters running in place during certain interactions in controller mode.
[*] Fixed errors in some prisoners' positions and actions.
[*] Fixed the issue of not being able to collect TV shopping packages at 5:30 PM.
[*] Fixed the occasional interaction prompt during combat in controller mode.
[*] Fixed the UI background frame shaking when picking up items.
[*] Fixed the issue of call charges and call counts being deducted even when the call failed.
[*] Fixed the potential freeze when skipping the morning roll call as a member of the Bigfoot gang on Riot Day.
[/list]
[h2][b]Future Plans[/b][/h2]

But that's not all—we're also eager to give you a glimpse into what’s brewing for the future! We are on track to complete the Thomas storyline this fall, culminating in his final attempt to break free. This conclusion is sure to bring satisfying twists and intense challenges!

In addition, we’re also happy to announce that Bob the Black Panther's storyline is in full production! Here's a sneak peek at what Bob is up to in his latest adventures 👇

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41416966/eac44762d6e00837009307b8b4e4d230c3ae0da3.gif[/img]
Stay tuned for more daring plots and intricate conspiracies as Bob takes on the challenges that lie ahead!

Thank you again for your support! We hope you enjoy the new content update for Thomas, and if you have any suggestions for improvements, please take some time to leave your comments or reviews on Steam!

notes.title: Public Test Branch New Updates!
notes.content:
Greetings Inmates!

We hope you've been busy plotting your escape within the daunting prison walls of Back to the Dawn. Since the release of our public opentest branch back in December, we've been thrilled to see so many of you take an early peek at our latest developments. This opportunity has not only allowed us to gather your invaluable feedback and suggestions but has also helped us fine-tune the experience before rolling it out to the main branch. 

Today, we're excited to share that we have implemented some feature optimizations and bug fixes to the opentest branch, making your journey towards freedom smoother and more engaging! After further review and testing, we will then roll out these new updates to the main branch for everyone to enjoy. 

Here are the updates:

[h3]Feature Optimizations[/h3]
[list]
[*]Added Steam cloud save functionality for the Opentest branch.
[*]Added the "Item Encyclopedia" feature: A popup button for "Item Encyclopedia" has been added in the "Character - Pocket" area. Players can now check information about items Thomas has carefully observed, such as item details, crafting recipes, store information, and prisoner possession information (prisoner possession information will only be displayed in the Item Encyclopedia after learning the "Criminal Profiler" specialization).
[/list]
[h3]Skill Adjustments[/h3]
[list]
[*]Added specialization "Criminal Profiler": Allows memorization of items on other prisoners and viewing them in the "Item Encyclopedia".
[*]Modified the "Second Strike" specialization: Changed to a triggered skill, players who have learned this specialization will automatically acquire and enable this skill.
[/list]
[h3]Bug Fixes[/h3]
[list]
[*] Fixed an issue where there was a probability of encountering display errors with Dudley in other scenes after leaving the tournament VIP lounge.
[*] Fixed an issue where there was a probability of endlessly pulling the cart on the rooftop when using a D-pad.
[*] Fixed an issue where after joining gangs other than Big Foot Gang, the dialogue for watching boxing matches still showed a charge of $40 instead of the actual $50 required.
[*] Fixed an issue where Esports Legend could not be started if the page was not refreshed after enabling the Pro Gamer skill.
[*] Fixed an issue where there was a probability of receiving a Weak Body debuff when crafting items on a workbench outside the cell room and your pocket capacity is exceeded.
[*] Fixed an issue where there was a probability of incorrect display of prisoners in Block B corridor during the Hanged Man event.
[/list]

If you’d like to play this opentest branch, you can find out more about how to access it here 👇
[url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/1735700/view/3902995340325203269]previous announcement. [/url]


[h3]Opentest Branch Guidelines[/h3]
[olist]
[*] Please note that the opentest branch is meant for early experimental testing, and the content might be adjusted along the way. Because of this, you might experience some bugs as well. But if you do, please let us know through our bug report form! Or if you have more feedback and suggestions for us, do let us know through the Steam Community discussions.

[*] We'll do our best to ensure save file compatibility between the opentest and the standard branch. However, just in case, we recommend backing up your save files before switching to the opentest branch. You can find your save files here: C:\Users\XXX\AppData\LocalLow\MetalHeadGames\Back To The Dawn (Replace XXX with your user folder name).

[*] If you choose to stay in the default branch, that's okay too! We will eventually push the latest and the most stable version to the main game after a thorough quality assurance check.
[/olist]
Once again, we appreciate everyone's support and love! If you enjoy the game or have any feedback or suggestions, please take some time to leave your comments on Steam or fill up our suggestion form [url=https://forms.gle/zQMzC8X7BVj5zPxq7]here[/url]. Your feedback is crucial as we strive to make your escape experience as thrilling and rewarding as possible.

We hope you enjoy these new updates and continue to join us in this thrilling journey of strategy and survival. Be sure to follow us on our social media if you haven’t too. Stay tuned for more updates, and have fun strategizing your next prison break!

notes.title: Introducing A Public Test Branch - A Sneak Peek Ahead!
notes.content:
Greetings, Inmates!

How have you been? We hope you have been enjoying the new features in our last major update so far. Today, we're bringing you not just one, but two exciting pieces of news that you won't want to miss!

[h2]Exclusive 10% Discount![/h2]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1735700/Back_to_the_Dawn/

First off, [b]from December 13 - 20[/b], we’re offering Back to the Dawn at a special 10% discount! If you've been eyeing this gripping prison survival adventure, now's the perfect time to take the plunge. And hey, why not spread the joy by recommending it to a friend? Dive into the intense, survival-focused world of Back to the Dawn and discover what lies within, all while saving a bit on your purchase.

[h2]New Public [i]opentest[/i] Branch![/h2]

Next, we’re thrilled to introduce a new Back to the Dawn [i]opentest[/i] branch on Steam for you to try out! This is your chance to get an early peek at the latest developments, which includes an array of new features from enhanced accessibility options to expanded gameplay elements. 

[h3]How to Access the [i]opentest[/i] Branch: [/h3]
[olist]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41416966/8fb6a59e8d8fedb19fd5a38d5895d7f0e77e87ca.jpg[/img]
[*] In your Steam library, right-click on Back to the Dawn and click on “Properties”.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41416966/8e2c61385a574aebf85a32614dd2a1a94c2f6de3.jpg[/img]
[*] In the Properties window, select "Betas", and under the “Beta Participation” dropdown menu, select “opentest” to opt in, and you are good to go!

[*] The game should shortly update itself after, and the game should display as “Back to the Dawn [opentest]” in your Steam Library. That’s how you know that you have successfully opted in! If you’d like to swap back to the original game, simply go through the same steps as above and select “None”.
[/olist]
[h3][i]Opentest[/i] Branch Guidelines[/h3]
[olist]
[*] Please note that the [i]opentest [/i]branch is meant for early experimental testing, and the content might be adjusted along the way. Because of this, you might experience some bugs as well. But if you do, please let us know through our [url=https://docs.google.com/forms/d/e/1FAIpQLSezGrYF2TBZMEwdf-2Ogag4KO1yhngr2XuF8YQTgH4w5EEBgA/viewform]bug report form[/url]! Or if you have more feedback and suggestions for us, do let us know through the Steam Community discussions.

[*] We'll do our best to ensure save file compatibility between the [i]opentest[/i] and the standard branch. However, just in case, we recommend backing up your save files before switching to the [i]opentest[/i] branch. You can find your save files here: C:\Users\XXX\AppData\LocalLow\MetalHeadGames\Back To The Dawn (Replace XXX with your user folder name).

[*] If you choose to stay in the default branch, that's okay too! We will eventually push the latest and the most stable version to the main game after a thorough quality assurance check.
[/olist]
[h3]Key Features and Optimizations in the [i]opentest[/i] Branch[/h3]
[list]
[*] Expanded walkable area in the sewer. Thomas can now freely move and change equipment after climbing out of the pipe.
[*] Added a new debuff: Accumulating smell from rummaging through trash affects charm value.
[*] Added a new debuff when facing the Crab Monster. Equip [spoiler]Amulet[/spoiler] to unlock a new battle move “Steadfast Will”: Pray against the monster to deal damage equal to the roll results and recover equal health.
[*] New operational guides in the skills page for stealing and extortion.
[*] New interaction options with the boxing manager, TV manager, and bank manager.
[*] Attribute tooltips now show maximum health and stamina for Strength, dodge chance for Agility, and critical hit chance for Intelligence.
[*] Added an option to delegate weightlifting to Thomas after three manual attempts.
[*] Reduced trust gain for befriending gang members from 10 to 8 points. Gain 2 trust points for meeting a gang prisoner.
[*] Weakened the negative effect of Gluttony: Changed from a chance to reduce 2 satiety points to reducing 5 mentality points when Hungry.
[*] Added a sorting function in the cabinet: New "Sort" button at the top left corner.
[*] Included a fast travel function between the first and second floor of the cell block.
[*] Added “Crafting Master” skill effect for solving puzzle games.
[*] Guided prompt for buying blankets.
[*] Sewer circuit repair can now be handled by Thomas after one failure.
[*] Additional guide for Gliding escape route.
[*] Added extra effect for “Police Uniform” armor: Opponents cannot deal critical hits to you.
[*] Reduced morale recovery effect of the Walkman, now provides additional charm experience per hour when turned on. Walkman automatically turns off when sleeping.
[*] New restriction on diarrhea medicine use: Cannot self-administer when in “Low Health”.
[*] You can apply to the guard for permission to go to the infirmary with the "Weak Body" status.
[*] Skip function for specific plot scenes: Phone call with Red, riot start scene, counting days in roll call animation, TV station entrance animation.
[*] Added special state “Potential Unleashed” for Pickman during the riot, enhancing his strength.
[*] New dialogue with Maggie during Honey Festival.
[*] Additional bargaining function for “Calculator”: Thomas can now bargain when shopping, costing 5 energy.
[*] Adjusted effect of “Mint Leaf”, “Mint Roll”, and “Fine Leaf Roll”: Health reduction is now cumulative based on daily usage of these items.
[*] Optimized the interaction with room items during a lockdown: Single cells do not require Sam's help to leave during the day.
[*] Added a trait where nearby fitness enthusiasts increase their favorability when you lift weights 10 times.
[*] Added new spectator interactions for tabletop games.
[*] Added a color vision assistance feature.
[*] Added new evening entertainment interactions on the second floor of the prison. You can [spoiler]“Play cards with Old Lee”, “Assist Phil in card gambling”, “Assist Lin in card gambling”, “Play tumbling tower with Crunchy”, “Play five finger fillets with Max”[/spoiler].
[*] Improved unlocking interaction for dismantling the sewer wooden board.
[*] Adjusted prisoner positions in roll call scenes for more accurate representation.
[*] Added fast-forward and real-time play buttons for watching boxing matches, along with a real-time information button.
[*] Added “Max” and “Min” quick selection buttons in the purchase item list.
[*] Default movement for Thomas changed to running, hold shift to walk.
[*] Added computer games in the comprehensive building and a preview option for the e-book “Time Crosser”.
[*] Increased experience gain for roofing work: 30 experience points per task completion.
[*] Optimized the experience gained for mini-games while working.
[*] Optimized some plot scenes and dialogues in the sewer area.
[*] Reduced listening time: From 5 minutes to 2 minutes.
[*] Lowered base difficulty for the “Framing Bag” task, but added a new roll debuff “Nearby Eyes”: Minus 1 point for each nearby prisoner.
[*] Added task mode hints in the task targets for beating Diego the Alpaca and Wilber the Goat.
[*] Added clue hints for collecting fingerprint film in task targets.
[/list]
[h3]Skill Optimizations[/h3]
[list]
[*] Updated the skill “Investment Expert” of Platypus Terry: Cash on hand increases by 5% every morning, with an additional 1% increase per Intelligence point.
[*] New effect for “Street Self-Defense 50 Moves”: No health loss if victorious in a fight.
[*] New skill “Round Up”: If the cumulative roll result is within 5 points of the maximum, it will be considered a completion.
[*] Hippo Frank’s talent move “Assassinate” now deals “full” damage.
[*] “Welcome to Hawkins” gains an extra effect: 20% increased damage to “Monsters”.
[*] New effect for the skill of Horse Ray in trading with other prisoners: Reduce favorability requirement by 2 points for each point of Charm.
[*] Enhanced “War Correspondent” talent armor “Thick Fur” with an extra effect: No health loss for sleeping without a blanket at night.
[*] Enhanced “Failure Scientist” skill: Double experience gain on failed roll challenges, and quintuple experience for critical failures.
[*] Enhanced Miguel the Tapir's skill “Reverse Hypnosis”: Nightmares bring additional abilities.
[*] New skill “Bookworm”: Preview book skills and reading actions no longer consume energy.
[*] Added new abilities to “Game Manual” and “TV Program Guide” book skills: Preview skills of games and TV shows.
[*] “Insect Farm” skill gains a minimum guarantee mechanism: If no gold beetles are found in 6 plant piles, the next pile will definitely have one.
[/list]
[h3]Quest Adjustments[/h3]
[list]
[*] Extended the deadlines of certain quests:
[list][*] “Two Ribs” completion deadline extended to 2 days.
[*] “Door-to-Door Delivery” and “Friendly Reminder” extended to 3 days.
[*] “Chameleon” completion deadline extended to 10 days.[/list] [*] Added a new task category “Escape”, separating escape-related side tasks.
[/list]
[h3]Bug Fixes[/h3]
Now let’s talk about some bug fixes we’ve done!
[list]
[*] Fixed an incorrect dialogue after Bruce [spoiler]is demoted[/spoiler] on the 21st morning roll call.
[*] Fixed an issue where newly unlocked items required reopening the page to reflect the updated favorability.
[*] Fixed trading transaction confirmation popup not appearing when trading with other prisoners.
[*] Fixed discrepancies in certain eavesdropping content after[spoiler]the riot.[/spoiler]
[*] Fixed an issue where wearing rubber gloves would revert damage status from broken to worn.
[*] Fixed an issue where prisoners in area A did not gather to watch the hanged man event.
[*] Fixed an error in selecting difficulty for new players.
[/list]
That wraps up today's update! If you have additional feedback or suggestions, feel free to reach out to us through the Steam Community discussions. Your feedback and support are the driving forces behind our dedication, and it is our guiding star as we continuously work to improve the game.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1735700/Back_to_the_Dawn/

Thank you once again for the encouragement you've given us, and we are thrilled to have you onboard in Boulderton Prison, plotting your epic breakout together with us!

notes.title: Our First Major Update!
notes.content:
Greetings, Inmates!

We hope you are well and thriving in your daring adventures within Boulderton Prison! Which escape route is your favorite so far? Let us know in the comments below!

Since our game's launch, your feedback and suggestions have been amazing, inspiring and guiding us towards making our game even better. And today, we're thrilled to announce our[b] first ever major update[/b], packed with feature optimizations, bug fixes, and some eagerly awaited new features that many of you have been asking for!

Without further ado, let’s dive right in! 👇

[h1]Difficulty Selection[/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41416966/21613c9f57ca83cde1592311acbe2b07d05b2b4f.jpg[/img]
We understand that every player brings a unique playstyle and set of preferences to the table. That's why we've introduced a new Difficulty Selection feature. You can choose among three modes, each with their unique perks and challenges! Whether you're looking to soak in the story at a leisurely pace or push your limits with zero memory recall option, these modes will give you the freedom to shape your adventure from the very beginning. Additionally, we've added new guidance for the new game modes to ensure a smooth and enjoyable experience.

[h1]New Game+ [/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41416966/64ba14777b56d2aa2028cce407021b86de244161.png[/img]
Survived your first stint in Boulderton Prison? Get ready to dive back in with New Game+! Keep all your hard-earned inmate relationships, specialties, and skills as you embark on a fresh journey. Get ready to navigate the treacherous world of Boulderton Prison, but this time being well prepared!

[h3]Feature Optimizations[/h3]
[list]
[*] Added a feature to skip cutscenes and conversations between inmates. Now, listening to inmate conversations can be skipped by long-pressing the right mouse button, and cutscenes can be skipped via a confirmation pop-up.
[*] Added a feature to skip work tasks. After repeating certain tasks several times, they can be delegated to Thomas to auto-complete.
[*] Optimized the frequency of the Chaplain's appearance. [spoiler] In the third week (day 15—21), the Chaplain will visit the prison every day.[/spoiler].
[*] Optimized the display position of the lack of Focus Point prompt when re-rolling after a failed steal attempt, to prevent it from being obscured by the screen.
[*] Added a puzzle replacement option. After failing a jigsaw puzzle several times, players can choose to accumulate dice rolls instead.
[*] Added "Pentacles" and "The Magician" achievements.
[*]Added a pop-up guide for adding skill points.
[*] Added a new combat debuff, "Diarrhea."
[*] Added an Easter Egg jailbreak route.
[*] Added an option to mix laxatives into food and share it with your tablemate to spike them.
[*] After confessing the jailbreak plan to Sam, Sam will no longer engage in cover-up related conversations with Thomas.
[*] It's now possible to visit Reed in the hospital with Maggie or Beth under specific conditions [spoiler] (Affection with Maggie or Beth is no less than 50).[/spoiler]
[*] Optimized the "Fish in a Tank" status. After obtaining the status, the “Weak Mind” trigger threshold is reduced by 10 points.
[*] Game cartridges that have been completed can now be exchanged.
[*] Optimized the display of the kitchen mini-game. After cooking more than 9 dishes, it no longer displays.
[*] If the recipient hates a gifted item, the item will remain in the player's inventory (but the Rapport will still decrease).
[*] In the absence of a hammer, the task of nailing together a wooden bridge in the sewer can be done using other items.
[*] It's no longer possible to retrieve the rope after reaching the bottom layer of the Pipe Area via the infirmary.
[*] Optimized the conditions to complete certain quests.
[*] Optimized performance issues in the “Rainy Night” and the sewer scene.
[*] Optimized some aspects of the tutorial interface display.
[*] Optimized some dialogue content.
[/list]
[h3]Skill Adjustments[/h3]
[list]
[*] Optimized the skill description for "Rumination+", which now extends duration by 100%.
[*] The "Ambush" status can stack up to 5 layers. Upon reaching full stacks, the "Total Hibernation" effect is activated, ensuring the next attack will hit.
[*] The attack effect of "Tiger Combo" is adjusted from end-of-turn to per-attack calculation. Subsequent combos triggered will no longer be affected by single-use buff consumption.
[*] "Pincer Smash" now includes a "guaranteed hit" effect, making the hit rate for this attack 100%.
[*] "Geek" has been modified to give +2 Intelligence and -1 Agility.
[*] Optimized the skill description for "Crushing Blow". When a critical hit is guaranteed, the hit rate is displayed as 100%.
[/list]
[h3]Bug Fixes[/h3]
[list]
[*] Fixed an issue where skipping Angelo's main storyline visit could prevent Reed's second visit from triggering.
[*] Fixed a problem where entering the infirmary during the day prevented leaving through the door.
[*] Fixed a bug where, after successfully helping Sam during the riot, Sam did not continue providing cover-up after day 19.
[*] Fixed a bug where using a controller made it impossible to select "Add Skill Points" after acquiring more than 24 skills.
[*] Fixed a bug where the discounted price of gang store items was incorrect after joining a gang.
[*] Fixed a bug where games could be played without a handheld game console when in segregation.
[*] Fixed a bug in the Central Garden stealth challenge where incorrect point bonuses were applied.
[*] Fixed a bug where "Mineworld Endless Mode" could be played when the current cartridge was not "Mineworld" or the handheld game console was out of power.
[*] Fixed a display bug where, during the riot lockdown, moving the camera to the corridor while Thomas was in a single room showed him in the cell on the first floor.
[*] Fixed a bug where the "Healing Rest" skill did not remove debuffs during combat.
[*] Fixed a bug where playing with a handheld game console in segregation would cause the game to freeze.
[*] Fixed a bug where a 10% discount from activating Billy's shopping benefit disappeared when increasing his Rapport to 100.
[*] Fixed a bug where, after successfully declaring your feeling to Beth, choosing "Cheer her up" did not increase her Affection for you.
[*] Fixed a bug where replacing battery in a powerless handheld game console was not possible if there were multiple sets of batteries in your pocket and the first set contained less than four batteries.
[*] Fixed a bug where the "Brass Knuckles" item's buff of +4 to unarmed attacks was not effective.
[*] Fixed a bug where snitching on Caesar caused his position to be fixed on the second floor of the Main Building on the morning of the same day in all saves, which caused a black screen for all the inmate conversations related to him.
[*] Fixed a display issue where the "Galactic Knight" buff still showed even when the player did not go first in a combat.
[*] Fixed a problem where the "Makeshift Mask" was not effective.
[*] Corrected inconsistency between the buff description and the actual HP deduction for arrow wounds.
[/list]
Your feedback and suggestions are important, as it helps us understand how we can improve Back to the Dawn. So please continue to share your experiences, suggestions, and any issues you encounter, we are all ears! Additionally, we will launch accessibility optimizations for mini-games in the next version!

If you’re enjoying the new updates and feel that we’ve addressed your concerns, we’d appreciate it if you could consider updating your review, especially if it was previously negative. Your positive feedback not only encourages us but also helps in continuously improving Back to the Dawn!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1735700/Back_to_the_Dawn/

Thank you once again for your ongoing support and enthusiasm. We hope you enjoy these new updates and continue to join us in this thrilling journey of strategy and survival. Stay tuned for more updates, and have fun strategizing your next prison break!

notes.title: Our New Update Is Live!
notes.content:
Greetings, Inmates!

It’s been close to a week since we launched Back to the Dawn, and we are absolutely humbled by the enthusiasm you’ve all shown. Watching you delve into the prison world we’ve created, forming alliances and rivalries with different inmates and sharing survival tips reminds us of the joy we felt during development and the immersive experience we aimed to create with the game. 

We’ve been taking in your feedback and suggestions as we continue to optimize the game, and today we're thrilled to announce that we have rolled out another new update with several feature optimizations and bug fixes, and [b]a new feature that many of you have been asking for![/b]

Here's a detailed breakdown of this update:

[h2]New Manual Save/Load Feature[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41416966/e7c0b167d5a40b110b296c27185555d78eb218b1.png[/img]
Added a manual save/load game functionality within Memory Recall, with a maximum of 10 save slots. Now, you can plan your escape with even more precision, save crucial moments before making pivotal decisions, and explore various pathways without losing progress! 

[h3]Feature Optimizations[/h3]
[list]
[*] Added an option to skip puzzles after multiple failed attempts in the mailroom and electrical room puzzles.
[*] Added new tutorials for attribute enhancement, prompts for gang orders, and tips related to donation bags.
[*] Adjusted the difficulty of dice rolls in the TV station scenes.
[*] Added a confirmation prompt button when adding skill points.
[*] Exercising in the dormitory, whether by the bed or using the small desk, now accumulates towards the same progress.
[*] Updated the successful connection prompt in the sewer valve adjustment minigame to display an arrow instead of a square.
[*] Optimized the illustrations for the glider and signal tower after a successful escape.
[*] Added ending text for the graveyard ending.
[*] Improved performance issues with animations during the rainy night scene and for some prisoners.
[*] Optimized certain in-game visuals and animation scenes.
[*] Optimized sound effects in the hospital.
[*] Optimized the loading screen icons.[/list]
[h3]Bug Fixes[/h3]
[list]
[*] Fixed an issue in the "After-Hours Consultation" quest where the "Corrosion Solution" made before receiving the task could not be used to fulfill the objectives.
[*] Fixed an issue with the time spent not halving in the kitchen and yard toilet areas after learning the “Iron Throne” skill.
[*] Fixed an issue where using the "Master Pickpocket" skill would result in negative money.
[*] Fixed an issue where the money stolen using the "Master Pickpocket" skill could exceed the victim’s total amount.
[*] Fixed an issue preventing the purchase of free bread when you have negative money.
[*] Fixed an issue where forcefully quitting the game could prevent re-entry into the game on subsequent attempts.
[*] Fixed an issue causing a game freeze when signing up for a boxing match and checking registration the next day.
[*] Fixed an issue with the game freezing when interacting with the door on the right after entering the operating room.
[*] Fixed certain incorrect timings in task completion evaluations.
[*] Fixed an issue where players could increase Father Anderson's favorability after his departure.
[*] Fixed an issue where staying in the cafeteria until 13:00 on riot day incorrectly forced a scene change.
[*] Fixed an issue with the endless ladder climbing animation for Thomas at low frame rates.
[*] Fixed an issue with the inability to interact with the ladder on the right side of the pipe area.
[*] Fixed an issue with overlapping prisoner positions and display errors in certain scenes.
[*] Fixed an issue in the mailroom warehouse where being over the time limit would forcibly move the player to the right side of the mailroom, and clicking on the cabinet behind the workbench at an angle would teleport back to the warehouse.
[*] Fixed an issue preventing exit from the hospital door when entering the operating room at night.
[*] Fixed an issue with the disappearance of time limits in hospital scenes after saving and quitting.
[*] Fixed an issue where players could get stuck when lying on the bed and selecting "Check under the bed" or "Tidy up the bed”.
[*] Fixed an issue where Franklin and Ray would appear on the first floor when brawling with Diego on the second night.
[*] Fixed an issue allowing computer usage despite having no remaining computer time.[/list]
In our previous announcement, we shared about an upcoming Difficulty Selection Mode feature. While this is still very much on our agenda, we decided to implement the manual save/load feature first as we believe it would offer more flexibility and control to your current playthroughs. Rest assured that we're in the midst of testing and fine tuning, and will keep you updated on our progress. Thank you for your understanding and patience!

We're grateful for your feedback and suggestions as they are key in refining Back to the Dawn at every step ahead. While we may not be able to implement all of them, we are committed to striking a balance between your expectations and the core essence of the game.

If you’re enjoying the new updates and feel that we’ve addressed your concerns, we’d appreciate it if you could consider to update your review, especially if was previously negative. Your positive feedback not only encourages us but also helps in continuously improving Back to the Dawn!

notes.content:
Greetings Inmates! 

We're incredibly grateful for the unwavering support and feedback you've shared since Back to the Dawn launched. Every piece of input you've sent our way hasn't gone unnoticed, and we plan to gradually improve and optimize the game based on your insights in subsequent updates. 

[h3]New Feature In Our Upcoming Update![/h3]
We'll also like to share that our upcoming update will introduce a [b]new feature — a Difficulty Selection Mode![/b] You will be able to choose an "Intern Reporter" difficulty mode to play, which will allow you to delve deeper into Thomas' story without the setbacks of repeated challenges within the game. So be sure to look out for this new addition soon!

In addition, we've continued our efforts to optimize and improve the game, and have just pushed out another bug fixes and optimizations update. Here are the full details:

[h3]Feature Optimizations[/h3] 
[list]
[*] Reduced the cost of Yogurt in vending machines

[*] Reduced the item level of "Painkiller" to 1, which can now be purchased from inmates after getting acquainted with them

[*] Increased the number of soap uses by one 
[*] Optimized the functionality of the "Lifeopedia" skill
[*] Removed the Chessboard item requirement to write down solutions for the puzzles in the General Building
[/list]
[h3]Bug Fixes[/h3] 
[list] 
[*] Fixed a soft lock issue that happens when navigating task prompts and opening the task panel under specific circumstances
[*] Fixed an issue where the "Pro Gamer" skill caused two game skills to appear at the same time
[*] Fixed an issue where lumber and "Playpup" were duplicated
[*] Fixed an issue where the points required to solve the puzzle in the General Building were different from the points needed in the Prison Cell
[*] Fixed a missing completion condition trigger for the third objective in the "Movie Mission" quest
[*] Fixed an issue in the "Another Key" quest which caused the Digital Watch not to be deducted from your inventory upon delivering the item
[*] Fixed an issue at the second floor lobby on the seventh night where the skunk inmate caused Thomas to be trapped in a corner after returning from a bath
[/list]
We hope that the above optimizations and fixes would make your experience within Boulderton Prison better. If you have any feedback, suggestions or any issues, we'd love to hear about it. Please do share it with us your either here on Steam or through our Discord channel.

If you enjoy the game, we would really appreciate if you could leave us a review on Steam. Your positive feedback is a tremendous encouragement and motivates us to continually improve. Thank you for your support and love!

notes.content:

Over the past few months, we have received a ton of fantastic feedback and suggestions from our community. Today, we would like to share some of the development progress and updates we have made with Back to the Dawn!

[h2]Sizzling New Kitchen Minigames![/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41416966/641c7ad4a754f618dd46807553c48f70bd7dcd92.png[/img]

We have heard your desire for more minigames and activities during the day, and we've got you covered! We are introducing brand new kitchen activities! Like the laundry room, the kitchen will be an additional work option for you to experience prison jobs during the day.

There are a wide variety of minigames in the kitchen to experience, such as washing dishes, peeling potatoes and pickling cucumbers that can be played via dice rolls! If you have enough strength stats, you can even try your hand at transporting ingredients.

Our goal is to capture the feeling of excitement as you  prepare various dishes during a prison mealtime to feed your fellow inmates. To achieve this, we are currently designing various types of mini-games from the ground up to let you immerse yourselves into roleplaying as a prison cook!

However, if you thought you would get a free meal from working in the kitchen, think again! Prisoners must be careful not to get caught stealing or cheating by the watchful chef, or face the consequences. If you are willing to take the risk, there are secret opportunities for you to sneak into the kitchen cellar to steal food, or who knows, you might even discover a new escape path in the kitchen.🤫
